purpose: Teacher-approved recurring Portfolio visual and wording contract. Student reports use the locked two-page family-facing HTML/PDF layout; teacher reports retain the approved intervention-first Class Overview / Whole Class / Priority Day Groups / Pull In Students design.
fidelity_rule: The HTML templates are canonical shells. Preserve fixed headings, section purposes, card anatomy, lane names, grading explanation, Priority Day capacity/ranking, and responsive digital student-report structure. Data changes; recurring structure does not drift.

student_packet.print_page_count_rule: Exactly 2 portrait pages per student for normal recurring reports.
student_packet.layout_rule: Page 1 shows current progress, Mastery Goal snapshot, and the complete Unit Evidence Picture. Page 2 shows recent evidence, Strengths, I Cans to improve, the Practice Builder link, and Current focus.
student_packet.unit_grade_rule: Do not display an overall Unit letter grade or large Unit-grade box.
student_packet.grading_explanation: Mastery Goal grades are based on current evidence, not averages, and can improve with new evidence. Use the I Can rows below to see what is secure and what needs another check.

mastery_goal_grade_display.assessed: Display `Grade {GRADE_CODE}` plus the course-policy label where space allows.
mastery_goal_grade_display.not_assessed: Display exactly `Not assessed`; family-facing meaning: this Mastery Goal has not been checked yet. Do not describe an unsuccessful attempt as Not assessed.
mastery_goal_grade_display.card_rule: Every MG card shows exact MG title/description, current grade display, secure-I-Can count, and every I Can row.

mastery_goal_layout.desktop: Two-column 2 x 2 Mastery Goal grid on page 1 when the unit has four Mastery Goals.
mastery_goal_layout.narrow_screen: One column on narrow screens; print restores the approved two-column layout.
mastery_goal_layout.rule: Every Mastery Goal and every I Can appears exactly once on page 1. Cards never split when printed.

practice_box.title: Your Practice
practice_box.instruction: Use this section to see what is already going well and what should be practiced next before another check.
practice_box.strengths: List up to four current secure/transfer I Cans as exact code + full statement.
practice_box.improve: List up to four assessed I Cans that currently need targeted practice or another independent check. Do not list unassessed Mastery Goals as weaknesses.
practice_box.builder_instruction: Practice Builder: open Unit {UNIT_NUMBER} and choose the I Cans listed above for targeted practice.
practice_box.preselection: Do not preselect an I Can. The Practice Builder URL contains Unit only.
practice_box.qr_rule: Do not include a QR code in the recurring report.
practice_box.missing_builder_rule: When the current course has no approved Practice Builder route, show the Strengths and I Cans to improve lists without fabricating a link.

student_packet.combined_packet_rule: class_student_packet.html contains one complete student-report article per active student in roster order. It is a convenient browser collection, not a duplex-print artifact.

teacher_summary.normal_page_budget: 3 pages when no Whole Class intervention is active; 4 pages when Whole Class is active.

class_overview.title: Class Overview
class_overview.rule: Fast-to-scan action page. Show compact current-grade/evidence stats, Major strengths, Highest-leverage pattern, and the three lane summaries. Do not include roster-upload or PowerSchool workflow instructions.

whole_class.rule: Use only for the highest-leverage genuinely shared instructional need. Show exact I Can code + full statement, affected current Practice + check count, recurring evidence-pattern summary, and one concise Teacher move. Include short Why this belongs in Whole Class and Keep the response short callouts. If no whole-class need is supported, omit the page and state that on Class Overview.

priority_day_groups.purpose: One weekly 20-minute Crewtime teacher-led intervention opportunity.
priority_day_groups.eligible_student_rule: Active student has at least one current assessed Mastery Goal grade of I AND at least one current PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can. Students whose only next step is NEEDS_ANOTHER_DEMONSTRATION or NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK are not assigned a Priority Day seat.
ranking_rule: Sort by count of current assessed Mastery Goal grades equal to I, descending.
Tie-break by count of current PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Cans, descending.
Tie-break by current evidence severity across those practice targets, prioritizing UNUSABLE before LIMITED before PARTIAL.
Use stable student_key order only as the final deterministic tie-break.
priority_day_groups.assignment_rule: Group 1 receives ranks 1-15. Group 2 receives ranks 16-30. Do not manufacture additional groups. If fewer than 30 eligible students exist, leave unused capacity empty. If more than 30 exist, show only a compact count of remaining eligible students waiting after Group 2; do not add a third group.
priority_day_groups.grouping_rule: Exact shared I Can bundles are NOT required. Within each selected group, summarize the dominant overlapping I Can needs and evidence patterns, then propose the best common 20-minute intervention. A small alternate practice strip may be used for a few outlier targets during the same session.
priority_day_groups.card_rule: Each group card shows priority rank, student count, target-frequency chips, compact student list with each student's PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can codes, evidence-backed group summary, and a 20-minute Crewtime plan with approximate time blocks.

pull_in_students.eligible_student_rule: Active students with exactly 1-2 current PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can gaps.
pull_in_students.rule: Student-centered compact grid. Show student name, period, and exact one or two I Can code + full statement targets. Never organize under shared I Can headings.
pull_in_students.banner_rule: State the action once in the banner; do not repeat a PLAN label on every student card.
pull_in_students.fit_rule: Keep every Pull In student on one landscape page. Use three columns normally and four columns when needed; reduce repeated wording before reducing legibility.
pull_in_students.overlap_rule: Priority Day and Pull In are scheduling views, not mutually exclusive intervention identities. A student may appear in both when the student is selected for a weekly Priority Day seat and also has only 1-2 actionable gaps suitable for short pull-in practice.
pull_in_students.exclusion_rule: Students who only need another independent demonstration are intentionally kept out of this lane.

teacher_summary.detailed_evidence_rule: Do not include a normal detailed I Can appendix in the recurring teacher report. Detailed longitudinal evidence remains in private Portfolio Data CSV/JSON state and may be produced separately only when the teacher explicitly requests it.

NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK.label: Needs first check
NEEDS_FIRST_CHECK.family_meaning: We have not checked this skill yet.

human_learning_label_rule: Always display canonical code and full exact I Can statement together in human-facing output.

results_zip.self_contained_html_rule: Individual student HTML must contain the essential CSS/markup needed for reliable offline browser viewing and optional later PDF conversion.
results_zip.identity_rule: For every student entry, student_key + student_name + individual report path must identify the same student. QA must verify the visible report identity before archive PASS. A filename/key mismatch with visible student identity is a hard failure.

fidelity_enforcement.renderer_rule: Read the exact canonical sources from the pinned SYSTEM commit and instantiate tokens/loops only. Do not author substitute report HTML, course-specific card anatomy, colors, typography, spacing, or a new stylesheet.
fidelity_enforcement.self_contained_rule: Replace the external portfolio.css link with one <style id="canonical-portfolio-css"> block containing the exact canonical portfolio.css bytes. No second visual stylesheet is allowed.
fidelity_enforcement.student_fit_rule: Normal student reports must preserve the locked two-page portrait layout. Recent evidence is capped at 4-8 distinct assessed I Cans as space permits; do not shrink away required Mastery Goal/I Can content.
fidelity_enforcement.provenance_rule: Every report-producing run records the pinned SYSTEM commit plus SHA-256 values for the student template, teacher template, CSS, and contract in results_manifest.json. Individual/teacher HTML includes corresponding template/CSS provenance meta tags.
fidelity_enforcement.pass_rule: Template validator PASS is required before Portfolio report QA may PASS.
